comparison.objective: Break an ampoule neck with a captive opener while retaining the cap; candidate installs a load-bearing rack rail.
comparison.physical_skill: Protected levering and breakaway control versus long-rail regrasping, spring-latch insertion, telescoping alignment, and driving screws.
comparison.success_condition: Confirmed neck break, captured cap, upright returned body, and released tools versus correctly handed four-point rail retention and prescribed screw placement.
comparison.reason: One tests controlled fracture and fragment capture; the other tests staged mechanical mounting across separated posts.
